structuredContent.name: tenants.set-tenant-configuration
structuredContent.description: Create or overwrite one configuration setting, a key with a string value, on an active tenant. Allowed for a global administrator or a TenantOwner of the tenant. A tenant holds at most 100 keys, so adding a new key beyond that is rejected while overwriting an existing key still works; setting a key to the value it already has changes nothing. Every tenant member can read the values, so do not store secrets.

TenantId.description: Identifier of the tenant to configure.

Key.description: Configuration key, at most 256 characters, case-sensitive. An existing key is overwritten.

Value.description: Configuration value, at most 1024 characters; an empty string is allowed.
